title: Your Holiday Gifts Are Costing You $147,500
hook: You'll spend $1,463 on gifts this season — Cornell proved your recipients only value them at fifty cents on the dollar.
angle: The economic deadweight loss of holiday gift-giving combined with a 30-year opportunity cost calculation most people never make.
audience: 25-45 year olds stressed about holiday spending and gift budgets
key_numbers: 50 cents per dollar — recipient value (Cornell research)
36% of Americans go into debt for holiday gifts
